acceptance: Owner-approved deployment/activation timestamp, exact source/artifact/version and sample start are recorded; runtime reads prove installed Theseus is the active single evaluator.

At least 7 days AND 60 unpooled post-change attempts have provenance and retained artifacts; report denominators, invalid verdicts, all-absent endings, follow-up absences, elisions, retries/spend and runtime. Meet existing targets or link owned residual-cause remediation items.

Closure table includes all prior observation obligations, platform-specific local/cloud smoke, new launcher/install reachability and latency/cadence samples without mixing epochs or claiming synthetic events as observations.

Final source-sync audit, all intended consumer migrations, source/artifact trust enforcement, state/finding/dispute readability, enforced Theseus governance and owner-run genuinely broken-gate recovery are verified with live evidence.

Published OSS source and installable hash-bound release exist; no obsolete active evaluator or unauthorized shim remains except the approved verbatim matcher. All mandatory implementation items reached their actual merge/deployment/measurement boundaries.
context: T10. Set a not_before of activation + 7 days when actual activation happens, not a guessed calendar date today; the attempt threshold and own-item holds still apply. Collection cadence must beat retention (existing reliability item requires collecting at least every 6 days).
description:
T10 is measured completion, not code merge. After owner-approved activation, start a new versioned epoch for installed Theseus. Retain artifacts before expiry and collect an unpooled post-change reliability sample of at least 7 days AND 60 actual attempts on the remediated deployed version. Targets follow the existing reliability item; either meet them or identify concrete residual causes in owned remediation TODOs. Never project success or pool pre/post samples. Ordinary traffic only; naturally observed disputes/reruns/stale-pending events must not be provoked.
Create the final closure table for every retained observation: item, implementation/version/hash, UTC window, attempt/event count, artifact/run provenance, outcome and next check if permitted to stay open. Natural-event obligations may remain open by their own acceptance with recorded window/count/next-check; old evidence retains old implementation identity. Reliability cannot be merely left open at extraction closure. Separate unchanged transport evidence from new installer/launcher reachability evidence and separately report latency/cadence epochs.
Guardrails: dates alone never establish completion. On a remediation source change restart/requalify the affected sample under existing acceptance; preserve retained prior epoch data. No production claims from focused tests. A1 external-adopter onboarding stays optional and outside this task and completion bar.
